NONE: › to cut something off in one quick movement
› informal to reduce a price or the amount of time taken to do something by a particular amount

example: I'll need to lop off the lower branches of the tree.
我要砍掉這棵樹上低矮的枝杈。
He lopped eight seconds off the record.
他將這項紀錄縮短了八秒鐘。

NONE: › (of a person or animal) to run taking long, relaxed steps
（人或動物輕鬆地））大步跑，大步跳躍

example: The lion loped across the grass.
獅子大步跳躍著跑過了草地。

NONE: › with one side bigger, higher, etc. than the other; not equally balanced
不平衡的，向一側傾斜的
